name: Dry Tortugas National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets may visit Garden Key but not Fort Jefferson; ferry and seaplane take no pets.
summary: Leashed pets may visit Garden Key but not Fort Jefferson; ferry and seaplane take no pets.

excerpts.quote: Pets are permitted on Garden Key but not inside Fort Jefferson.
Pets are not permitted on any other key in the park.

dogRules.text: Allowed on Garden Key, outside Fort Jefferson.
The ferry and seaplane do not carry pets; come by private boat.
